title: CampusConnect V1 Release Planning and Database Strategy
summary: The team reviewed the remaining tasks for the CampusConnect v1 release, confirming that the user profile API and UI updates are on track for completion by this coming Friday. Design assets for onboarding screens were delayed due to college events but are committed for delivery by the day after tomorrow. The team decided to defer the migration from SQLite to PostgreSQL to v2 to maintain v1 scope. A full testing plan is due next week Wednesday, while the README update remains unassigned and pending.
key_points: The team assessed the status of v1 release deliverables, including backend APIs, frontend UI, design assets, and testing.
The team debated whether to migrate from SQLite to PostgreSQL for v1 or defer it to v2.
The README file on GitHub was identified as outdated, but no immediate owner was assigned.
decisions: Defer migration from SQLite to PostgreSQL to v2; v1 will continue using SQLite.

action_items.task: Complete user profile API including session handling edge case fix
Upload new onboarding screen design assets to Figma
Complete full test plan for all modules
